node.statement: By equation (1.6) in def-routef-raw-factor-setting, C_Upsilon+2*(C_2+C_theta+C_Delta) <= K. Since eta, ||X||, and ||Y|| are nonnegative, multiplication preserves this inequality; combining it with 1.4.1 proves the asserted estimate simultaneously for every r >= 1 and all X,Y in M_r(B).
